interventions.title: Grow smoke-free days
interventions.summary: Keep the bike commute and add two fully smoke-free days this week. No products suggested here — your care team can help if you want extra support.

interventions.title: Two alcohol-free evenings
interventions.summary: Pick two weeknights that stay drink-free. Swap the usual glass for a sparkling water ritual you actually like.

interventions.title: Protect the commute habit
interventions.summary: Your cycling already shows up as a plus. Lock in three bike days and treat missed rain days as a walk, not a write-off.
